subject: Scaled chi-square difference tests - error messages and contradictory results between methods

messages.author: 34bfdf46c107985b
messages.subject: Scaled chi-square difference tests - error messages and contradictory results between methods
parts:
Dear Yves,

Working in lavaan 0.5-19, I am conducting confirmatory factor analysis and comparing different models (e.g. 4-factor model vs. 3-factor model) estimated with cfa() with MLR as method) with lavTestLRT(). I have used the method options "satorra.2000", "satorra.bentler.2001" and "satorra.bentler.2010).

1. When using the option "satorra.2000", I obtain the following error message:


Error in lav_test_diff_af_h1(m1 = m1, m0 = m0) : 
  lavaan ERROR: unconstrained parameter set is not the same in m0 and m1

What does this mean?
The only option I could think of was that only "parameter-nested" models could be compared (i.e. when a few parameters are constrained to 0, as opposed to a different factor structure). So I checked this by running a model where I only constrained some error correlations, but I still had had the same error message.


2. The other two methods run without problems, but I obtained a (inadmissible) negative chi-square test statistic under satorra.bentler.2010 and a positive one using satorra.2000. In my understanding, satorra.bentler.2010 should, however, guarantee that only positive test statistics are obtained.

Any idea what could be going on?


Many thanks for your help,

Franziska

On 10/23/2015 12:47 PM, Franziska Zuber wrote:
> 1. When using the option "satorra.2000", I obtain the following error
> message:
>
> Error in lav_test_diff_af_h1(m1 = m1, m0 = m0) : lavaan ERROR:
> unconstrained parameter set is not the same in m0 and m1

> What does this mean?

(Apologies for the late reply; I am going through the archive to catch
unanswered emails from October)

It means that the models are not nested in the parameter sense: m0 is
not a strict subset of m1. I contains some 'free' parameters that were
fixed in m1.

A common setting for this is using group.equal =
c("intercepts","loadings"), which will generate a 'm0' model that is
restricted (intercepts and loadings constrained to be equal), BUT, it
will have set some factor means/intercept free, while they were still
fixed to zero in the m1 model.

This is currently only an issue when using "satorra.2000", at least in
the current implementation (0.5-20).

> The only option I could think of was that only "parameter-nested" models
> could be compared

> opposed to a different factor structure). So I checked this by running a
> model where I only constrained some error correlations, but I still had
> had the same error message.

Hm. That should not happen. Can you provide a small reproducible example
for this?

> 2. The other two methods run without problems, but I obtained a
> (inadmissible) negative chi-square test statistic under
> satorra.bentler.2010 and a positive one using satorra.2000. In my
> understanding, satorra.bentler.2010 should, however, guarantee that only
> positive test statistics are obtained.

That was also my understanding. Can you post (a snippet of) your data
and a script to reproduce this? I would like to investigate this further.

Yves.
